# apple_webhook_deliveries (Data Source)

Lists a webhook's deliveries, for example to find failed ones to send again with `apple_redeliver_webhook`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_webhook_deliveries" "failed" {
  webhook_id = apple_webhook.builds.id
  states     = ["FAILED"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `webhook_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the webhook.

### Optional

- `states` (Set of String) Only deliveries in these states. Values: `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, `PENDING`.

### Read-Only

- `deliveries` (Attributes List) The deliveries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deliveries))

<a id="nestedatt--deliveries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deliveries`

Read-Only:

- `created_date` (String) When the event was created.
- `error_message` (String) Why the delivery failed.
- `http_status_code` (Number) HTTP status the receiver returned.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the delivery.
- `redelivery` (Boolean) Whether this delivery sent an earlier one again.
- `sent_date` (String) When the delivery was sent.
- `state` (String) State of the delivery: `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, `PENDING`.
